Service.title: Service
Service.description: A bookable service offering with full catalogue dimensions per bookings-service-catalog (REQ-SC-001..008). Extends the minimal Service declared by bookings-create-appointment with stable per-administration `code` slug, temporal dimensions (`prepareTime`, `bufferBefore`, `bufferAfter`), pricing (`basePrice`, `currency`, `dynamicPricing` flag), categorisation (`serviceCategory`, `resourceTypeRef`), and a three-state lifecycle (`draft` → `active` → `archived`). `dynamicPricing: true` signals to dependent specs (T2+) that base price is a fallback; rule-based pricing must be applied. `resourceTypeRef` is a forward FK to dependent resource-type specs (skill/room/staff specialty/equipment class) and is interpreted by `bookings-resource-calendar` / `bookings-availability-rules` / future resource-allocation specs. Multi-tenant isolation via `administrationId` per ADR-005. Total calendar block per scheduled service = `prepareTime + duration + bufferAfter`; the next allowed slot starts after `bufferBefore + duration + bufferAfter` per REQ-SC-003 worked examples.

code.description: Stable slug identifier unique per administration (REQ-SC-008). Once assigned MUST NOT change — dependent specs reference it for reporting, mapping and external integrations.
code.title: Code

prepareTime.description: Setup/preparation time in minutes applied BEFORE the service window (REQ-SC-003). Total calendar block = prepareTime + duration + bufferAfter.
prepareTime.title: Prepare Time

bufferBefore.description: Gap in minutes required before this service begins (REQ-SC-003); typically 0 for collocated resources, > 0 for travelling staff.
bufferBefore.title: Buffer Before

bufferAfter.description: Gap in minutes after this service ends for turnover/cleaning (REQ-SC-003). Dutch SMB default: 15 minutes for high-turnover services (salons), 0 for low-turnover (consulting).
bufferAfter.title: Buffer After

basePrice.description: Base unit price in the specified currency (REQ-SC-004). Stored as decimal with two-cent precision (multipleOf 0.01). If dynamicPricing = false this is the final price; if dynamicPricing = true this is a fallback / reference only and dependent pricing specs MUST compute actual price via rules.
basePrice.title: Base Price

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (REQ-SC-002); default EUR for Dutch organisations.
currency.title: Currency

dynamicPricing.description: If true (REQ-SC-004), dependent pricing specs (T2+) MUST compute actual price via time-of-day, volume, surge or other rules; basePrice MUST NOT be used as the final price. If false, basePrice is the final price and no further pricing lookup is required.
dynamicPricing.title: Dynamic Pricing

serviceCategory.description: Flat category grouping per REQ-SC-006 (e.g. "Hair Services", "Consulting", "Catering", "Subscriptions"). Nested hierarchies deferred to T2.
serviceCategory.title: Service Category

resourceTypeRef.description: Optional forward FK to resource-type concepts (skill, room, staff specialty, equipment class) per REQ-SC-007. Resolved by dependent specs (bookings-resource-calendar, bookings-availability-rules). Null for services with no specific resource requirement (subscriptions, products).
resourceTypeRef.title: Resource Type Ref

status.description: Three-state lifecycle per REQ-SC-005. `draft` = under construction, NOT bookable; `active` = live and bookable, visible in catalogs; `archived` = retired, retained for audit, NOT bookable.
status.title: Status

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Service is incomplete or under development; NOT bookable. Excluded from booking catalogs.

active.label: Active
active.description: Service is live and bookable; visible in catalogs and to the self-service widget.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Service is retired; retained for historical/audit purposes; NOT bookable but still queryable for past bookings.

activate.label: Activate service
activate.description: Publish a draft service so it becomes bookable (REQ-SC-005).

archive.label: Archive service
archive.description: Retire an active service. Past bookings remain queryable (REQ-SC-005).

x-openregister-uniqueness.description: Service code MUST be unique per administration (REQ-SC-008). Same code MAY exist in different administrations.

countByStatus.description: Number of services per lifecycle state.

countByCategory.description: Number of services per flat category grouping (REQ-SC-006).

objects.name: Monthly SaaS Subscription
objects.description: Standard plan: up to 5 users, email support.
